patterns.name: 〜くたびれる
patterns.explanation: くたびれる added to a verb stem says you got worn out from doing it. まちくたびれた = 'got tired of waiting'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, boyish way to push your words at the listener; here it is drawn out. まちくたびれたぞー = 'I'm tired of waiting, you hear!'.
